title: Prince Cloud
description: Convert Markdown, HTML, and web pages to high-quality PDF with Prince.
summary: Convert Markdown, HTML, and web pages to high-quality PDF with Prince.
offersHint: Convert Markdown, HTML, and web pages to high-quality PDF with Prince. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://prince.cloud/mcp

toolsPreview.name: url_to_pdf
toolsPreview.description:
Fetch a URL and convert it to PDF using Prince.

    Args:
        url: URL of a document to fetch and convert
        style: Additional CSS to apply (inline stylesheet content)
        page_size: Page size (e.g., A4, letter)
        page_margin: Page margins (e.g., 20mm)
        javascript: Enable JavaScript execution
        pdf_profile: PDF profile (e.g., PDF/A-3b, PDF/UA-1)
        output_filename: Output filename for the PDF (default: "output.pdf")
